assumptions: Fixed Unicode-code-point windows, half-open offsets into title + newline + description + newline + body (same canonical text as flat baseline). Exact splitter unspecified in paper. Whole ranked chunks including overlap; no merging, summarization, identity routing or character cap. Metadata uses unchanged runner serialization. Hybrid reconstruction choices: Qwen 8B variant, normalized vectors, cosine derived from L2, per-candidate-set min-max scaling, BM25Okapi with Unicode word tokenization. These details are unspecified by the paper.
retrieval: Nebius Qwen3-Embedding-8B, FAISS IndexFlatL2 top 60, rank-bm25, 60/40 min-max score fusion, task-specific k; no character cap.
split: Fresh deterministic stratified questions excluding all supplied prior evaluation reports and the base selection
scope: Paper-style hybrid retrieval reconstruction on the available corpus; not exact original ProAgent replication. Fresh questions, frozen before retrieval; same Opus generator.

sampling.allocation: Proportional largest remainder by subtype; ERR also balances is_correct strata
sampling.withinStratum: SHA-256(seed:task:id), ascending; no answer or model-performance filtering

embedding.queryInstruction: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query

usage.costNote: Estimate at $0.01/M, not an invoice. Failed/retried or uncommitted responses may incur additional charges.

queryEmbeddingUsageBefore.costNote: Estimate at $0.01/M, not an invoice. Failed/retried or uncommitted responses may incur additional charges.

queryEmbeddingUsageAfter.costNote: Estimate at $0.01/M, not an invoice. Failed/retried or uncommitted responses may incur additional charges.

hybridRetrieval.scoreScaling: independent min-max over dense candidates; constant channel contributes zero
hybridRetrieval.lexicalStatistics: whole profile corpus, then score the 60 dense candidates
hybridRetrieval.tokenization: Python Unicode casefold, regex \w+, no stemming/stopword removal
hybridRetrieval.ties: hybrid descending, squared L2 ascending, source row order ascending

retrievalTimingScope: FAISS + BM25 + fusion; cached query embedding time excluded

PQA.tokenCountScope: Whole CLI request including system/question/cache; evidence-only token count unavailable

ORD.tokenCountScope: Whole CLI request including system/question/cache; evidence-only token count unavailable

ERR.tokenCountScope: Whole CLI request including system/question/cache; evidence-only token count unavailable

GEN.tokenCountScope: Whole CLI request including system/question/cache; evidence-only token count unavailable

orderingCoverageMethod: Exact normalized root or section title; unresolved availability is unknown
primaryScorePolicy: Exclude provider biology refusals only; retain other call/parse/evaluator failures as zero. Original allQuestionScores and official metrics are preserved for audit.
